---
title: "Calculate ALL vs. NO track errors"
format: html
editor: visual
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(geosphere)

# Set the working directory to the project root
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())

SAVE_FIG <- FALSE
SAVE_DATA <- FALSE

output_dir <- "Hurricanes_output/augmented_obs"
```

# 1. Load and process the track data

```{r}
if (!SAVE_DATA) {
  tracks_best <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tracks_best.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  tracks_all <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tracks_all.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  tracks_no <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tracks_no.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  tracks_forecast <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tracks_forecast.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  tracks_data <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tracks_data.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  ATCF_headers <- c("BASIN", "CY", "YYYYMMDDHH", "TECHNUM", "TECH", "TAU", 
                                "LAT", "LON", "VMAX", "MSLP", "TY", "RAD", 
                                "WINDCODE", "RAD1", "RAD2", "RAD3", "RAD4", 
                                "POUTER", "ROUTER", "RMW", "GUSTS", "EYE", 
                                "SUBREGION", "MAXSEAS", "INITIALS", "DIR", 
                                "SPEED", "STORMNAME", "DEPTH", "SEAS", 
                                "SEASCODE", "SEAS1", "SEAS2", "SEAS3", 
                                "SEAS4")


  # The raw DAT files have inconsistent number of columns, with first rows ending without the last columns.
  # The code below fixes that by reading the file and forcing it to complete rows_append()
  # Read the file as plain text
  complete_DAT_rows <- function(file, type) {
      lines <- readLines(file)
      
      # Ensure all rows have the correct number of columns by appending commas
      lines <- sapply(lines, function(line) {
        cols <- strsplit(line, ",")[[1]]
        if (length(cols) < length(ATCF_headers)) {
          paste(c(cols, rep("", length(ATCF_headers) - length(cols))), collapse = ",")
        } else {
          line
        }
      })
    return(lines)
  }



  # Function to process each file
  read_track <- function(file, type) {
      
      # Read the file and complete rows
      lines <- complete_DAT_rows(file, type)

      # Write the corrected lines to a temporary file
      temp_file <- tempfile()
      writeLines(lines, temp_file)

      read_csv(temp_file, col_names = ATCF_headers, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      select(BASIN, CY, YYYYMMDDHH, TAU, LAT, LON, VMAX, RAD1, RAD2, RAD3, RAD4, STORMNAME) %>%
      # Enforce types
      mutate(BASIN = as.character(BASIN),
            CY = as.integer(CY),
            file_time = as.character(YYYYMMDDHH),
            TAU = as.integer(TAU),
            LAT = as.character(LAT),
            LON = as.character(LON),
            VMAX = as.numeric(VMAX),
            RAD1 = as.integer(RAD1),
            RAD2 = as.integer(RAD2),
            RAD3 = as.integer(RAD3),
            RAD4 = as.integer(RAD4),
            STORMNAME = as.character(STORMNAME)) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      # Convert latitude to decimal format: Format ix XXXH. Divide XXX by 10. Then, if H = S, assign negative sign
      mutate(LAT = ifelse(str_detect(LAT, "S"), -as.numeric(str_sub(LAT,1,-2))/10, as.numeric(str_sub(LAT,1,-2))/10),
            LON = ifelse(str_detect(LON, "W"), -as.numeric(str_sub(LON,1,-2))/10, as.numeric(str_sub(LON,1,-2))/10),
            forecast_type = type,
            forecast_time = ymd_h(file_time) + hours(TAU),
            hurricane_id = paste(BASIN, CY, year(forecast_time), sep = "_")) %>%
      select(hurricane_id,
            hurricane_name = STORMNAME,
            file_time,
            forecast_type,
            forecast_time,
            lead_time = TAU,
            lat = LAT,
            lon = LON,
            vmax = VMAX,
            rad1 = RAD1,
            rad2 = RAD2,
            rad3 = RAD3,
            rad4 = RAD4)
  }

  # Load the best track data
  dat_files_best <- list.files(path = file.path(here(), "Hurricane_data/NHC_files"), pattern = "\\.dat$", full.names = TRUE)
  tracks_best <- dat_files_best %>% map_dfr(read_track, type = "Best")
  tracks_best <- tracks_best %>%
    rename(lat_best = lat,
          lon_best = lon,
          vmax_best = vmax,
          rad1_best = rad1,
          rad2_best = rad2,
          rad3_best = rad3,
          rad4_best = rad4)


  # Load the ALL track data
  dat_files_all <- list.files(path = file.path(here(), "Hurricane_data/NHC_files/ALL"), pattern = "\\.atcfunix$", full.names = TRUE)
  tracks_all <- dat_files_all %>% map_dfr(read_track, type = "All")
  tracks_all <- tracks_all %>%
    select(-hurricane_name) %>%
    rename(lat_all = lat,
          lon_all = lon,
          vmax_all = vmax,
          rad1_all = rad1,
          rad2_all = rad2,
          rad3_all = rad3,
          rad4_all = rad4)


  # Load the NO track data
  dat_files_no <- list.files(path = file.path(here(), "Hurricane_data/NHC_files/NO"), pattern = "\\.atcfunix$", full.names = TRUE)
  tracks_no <- dat_files_no %>% map_dfr(read_track, type = "No")
  tracks_no <- tracks_no %>%
    select(-hurricane_name) %>%
    rename(lat_no = lat,
          lon_no = lon,
          vmax_no = vmax,
          rad1_no = rad1,
          rad2_no = rad2,
          rad3_no = rad3,
          rad4_no = rad4)


  # Merge All and No keeping only the matches
  tracks_forecast <- inner_join(tracks_all %>% select(-forecast_type),
                                tracks_no %>% select(-forecast_type), 
                                by = c("hurricane_id", "file_time", "forecast_time", "lead_time"))

  # Merge with Best track (this will lead to cartesian match because of different lead times for a single prediction time)
  tracks_data <- inner_join(tracks_forecast,
                              tracks_best  %>% select(-file_time, -forecast_type, -lead_time), 
                                by = c("hurricane_id", "forecast_time")) %>%
                  arrange(hurricane_id, forecast_time, lead_time)

  # Save all tracks files
    write_csv(tracks_best, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_best.csv"))
    write_csv(tracks_all, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_all.csv"))
    write_csv(tracks_no, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_no.csv"))
    write_csv(tracks_forecast, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_forecast.csv"))
    write_csv(tracks_data, file.path(output_dir, "tracks_data.csv"))
}
```

Merge with landfall data and calculate time relative to landfall

```{r}
landfall_data <- read_csv(file.path(here(), "Hurricane_data/NHC_files", "landfall_times.csv")) %>%
  select(-hurricane_name) %>%
  mutate(landfall_time = ymd_h(landfall_time))

tracks_data <- tracks_data %>%
  left_join(landfall_data, by = "hurricane_id") %>%
  mutate(time_to_landfall = as.numeric(difftime(landfall_time, ymd_h(file_time), units = "hours")))
```

# 2. Plot track data

Plot the tracks for each storm using the full data available for best, all, and no forecasts

```{r}
unique_ids <- unique(tracks_data$hurricane_id)

for (hurr_id in unique_ids) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_path(data = tracks_best %>% filter(hurricane_id == hurr_id), aes(x = lon_best, y = lat_best, color = "Best"), linewidth = 1.5, arrow = arrow(ends = "last")) +
    geom_path(data = tracks_all %>% filter(hurricane_id == hurr_id), aes(x = lon_all, y = lat_all, group = file_time, color = "All"), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_path(data = tracks_no %>% filter(hurricane_id == hurr_id), aes(x = lon_no, y = lat_no, group = file_time, color = "No"), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(title = paste("Tracks for", hurr_id),
         x = "Longitude",
         y = "Latitude") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Best" = "black", "All" = "blue", "No" = "red"), name = "Forecast Type") +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  if (SAVE_FIG) ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "track_errors", paste0(hurr_id, ".png")), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
}
```

Next, plot tracks only with matched data points (with the tracks_data dataframe)

```{r}
for (hurr_id in unique_ids) {
  p <- ggplot(tracks_data %>% filter(hurricane_id == hurr_id)) +
    geom_path(aes(x = lon_best, y = lat_best, color = "Best"), linewidth = 1.5, arrow = arrow(ends = "last")) +
    geom_path(aes(x = lon_all, y = lat_all, group = file_time, color = "All"), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_path(aes(x = lon_no, y = lat_no, group = file_time, color = "No"), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(title = paste("Matched Tracks for", hurr_id),
         x = "Longitude",
         y = "Latitude") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Best" = "black", "All" = "blue", "No" = "red"), name = "Forecast Type") +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  if (SAVE_FIG) ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "track_errors", paste0(hurr_id, "_matched.png")), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
}
```

# 3. Calculate Euclidean distances and plot errors

Calculate Euclidian distances to prediction nodes

```{r}
MILES_TO_M <- 1609.344
tracks_data <- tracks_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    track_error_all = distHaversine(c(lon_best, lat_best), c(lon_all, lat_all))/MILES_TO_M,
    track_error_no = distHaversine(c(lon_best, lat_best), c(lon_no, lat_no))/MILES_TO_M
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```


There is a little variation of lead time multiples

```{r}
table(tracks_data$lead_time)
```

Group into ranges of 6 hours to account for minor changes in hours

```{r}
tracks_data_grouped <- tracks_data %>%
  mutate(lead_days_group = (lead_time %/% 24),
         dtl_group = (time_to_landfall %/% 24),
        #  dtl_group = cut(
        #    time_to_landfall/24,
        #    breaks = seq(-9, 18, by = 3),
        #    right = FALSE,
        #    include.lowest = TRUE
        #  ),
         error_reduc = track_error_no - track_error_all) %>%
  group_by(lead_days_group, dtl_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_track_error_all = mean(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_track_error_all = sd(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_track_error_all = quantile(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_track_error_all = quantile(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_track_error_no = mean(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_track_error_no = sd(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_track_error_no = quantile(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_track_error_no = quantile(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95),
    mean_error_reduc = mean(error_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_error_reduc = sd(error_reduc, na.rm = TRUE),
    p05_error_reduc = quantile(error_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.05),
    p95_error_reduc = quantile(error_reduc, na.rm = TRUE, probs = 0.95)
  )
```

Plot a graph comparing mean errors of all vs no with shades for intervals 05--95
```{r}
ggplot(tracks_data_grouped %>% filter(dtl_group < 0 & dtl_group >= -6), aes(x = lead_days_group)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = -dtl_group), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_track_error_all, color = "All")) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p05_track_error_all, ymax = p95_track_error_all, fill = "All"), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_track_error_no, color = "No")) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p05_track_error_no, ymax = p95_track_error_no, fill = "No"), alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ dtl_group, ncol = 3) +
  xlim(0, 5) +
  labs(title = "Track Error Comparison",
       subtitle = "Grouped by forecast run to landfall gap (orange line)",
       x = "Lead days",
       y = "Track Error (miles)",
       color = "Forecast Type",
       fill = "Forecast Type") +
  theme_minimal()
if (SAVE_FIG) ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "track_errors", "track_error_comparison_pre_lf.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

Same as above but with relative reduction in errors (i.e, errors of ALL minus errors of NO diveded by errors of NO)

```{r}
ggplot(tracks_data_grouped %>% filter(dtl_group < 0 & dtl_group >= -6), aes(x = lead_days_group)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = -dtl_group), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_error_reduc)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p05_error_reduc, ymax = p95_error_reduc), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ dtl_group, ncol = 3, scale = "free_y") +
  xlim(0, 5) +
  labs(title = "Error reduction",
       subtitle = "Grouped by forecast run to landfall gap (orange line)",
       x = "Lead days",
       y = "Error reduction (miles)") +
  theme_minimal()
if (SAVE_FIG) ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "track_errors", "track_error_gain_pre_lf.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

Stack graphs with horizontal axis in time relative to landfall

```{r}
ggplot(tracks_data_grouped %>% filter(dtl_group < 0 & dtl_group >= -6), aes(x = lead_days_group+dtl_group)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_error_reduc, color = factor(dtl_group), group = dtl_group)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Run to Landfall gap (days)",
                        option = "D",
                        begin = 0.1,
                        end = 0.9,
                        labels = function(x) paste0(x, " days")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-5, 5, by = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Error reduction",
       x = "Time to landfall (days)",
       y = "Error reduction (miles)") +
  theme_minimal()
if (SAVE_FIG) ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "track_errors", "track_error_gain_pre_lf_ttl.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```


Now, for each storm

```{r}
tracks_data_grouped_hurr <- tracks_data %>%
  filter(time_to_landfall < 0 & time_to_landfall >= -6*24) %>%
  mutate(lead_days_group = (lead_time %/% 24)) %>%
  group_by(hurricane_id, lead_days_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    hurricane_name = last(hurricane_name),
    mean_track_error_all = mean(track_error_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_track_error_no = mean(track_error_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    tracks_max_vmax = max(vmax_best, na.rm = TRUE),
  ) %>%
  mutate(error_gain = mean_track_error_no - mean_track_error_all)
```

```{r}
ggplot(tracks_data_grouped_hurr, aes(x = lead_days_group)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = error_gain, color = hurricane_name), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray20", size = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Track Error Reduction with Augmented Obs.",
       x = "Lead Time (hours)",
       y = "Track Error difference (miles)",
       color = "Hurricane") +
  theme_minimal()
if (SAVE_FIG) ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "track_errors", "track_error_gain_per_hurricane.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

What storms were the most intense? To do so, calculate the maximum vmax_best for each storm and rank them.

```{r}
tracks_max_vmax <- tracks_best %>%
  group_by(hurricane_id) %>%
  summarise(max_vmax_best = max(vmax_best, na.rm = TRUE),
            hurricane_name = last(hurricane_name)) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_vmax_best))
tracks_max_vmax
``` 

Color code intensity of the storm in the plot
```{r}
ggplot(tracks_data_grouped_hurr, aes(x = lead_time_group)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = error_gain, group = hurricane_name, color = tracks_max_vmax), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray20", size = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Track Error Reduction with Augmented Obs.",
       x = "Lead Time (hours)",
       y = "Track Error difference (miles)",
       color = "Hurricane") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "yellow", high = "blue", name = "Max VMAX", transform = "log10") +
  theme_minimal()
if (SAVE_FIG) ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "track_errors", "track_error_gain_per_hurricane_intensity.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```
